verification.note: Fresh complete article PDF obtained from public CUNY teaching copy; selected printed15–16/main Cott discussion and notes13–14 read. Remaining article not claimed fully read. Kerber specifically describes Cott’s extension of Thompson’s task/time distinction and domesticity/feminism account. This is reception and conceptual use; not a claim that Kerber agrees with every Cott conclusion or a specific personal criticism of Cott.

cott_beard_letters.note: Fresh selected authorial preface xi and discontinuous introduction passages including displayed48 and later unpaginated text recovered through indexed primary transcription at https://dokumen.pub/a-woman-making-history-mary-ritter-beard-through-her-letters-9780300162585.html. Copyright1991 by Cott, not host’s2022 metadata. Own editorial account explains selection, interspersed commentary, omitted late letters attacking husband’s critics, ellipses, supplied brackets and corrections. An unpaginated retained paragraph beginning She considered identifies a particular limitation in Beard’s treatment of domesticity and public opportunity. Full letters and complete introduction remain unread; no all141-letters reading claim. Earlier publisher-metadata-only verification remains a historical record, extended rather than overwritten.
